items.title: Tesla, Amazon, and SpaceX among companies snubbing tokenized stocks

items.title: Lam Research Lost 34% in a Month. Bernstein Sees 53% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLam Research stock is down 34% in the past month. A record September quarter came with a December-quarter guide only in line with estimates, and fears about AI spending hit Applied Materials and the rest of the chip-equipment group too.

items.title: Applied Materials Just Dropped 29% In a Month: Will November 12 Earnings Rescue or Break AMAT Stock?
items.summary: Applied Materials has shed nearly a third of its value in a single month, and the chip equipment giant's November 12 earnings report now stands as either the catalyst for a recovery or proof the selloff has further to run.
